subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

He became the first Indian to be invited to perform at the __advantageous__ Maple Theatre in Canada.
solution:
The correct answer is **Prestigious.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Advantageous** means that will help you or bring you a good result.

 -Example: The trade agreements are advantageous to both countries.

 
• Marked option Prestigious having prestige or honoured.

 -Example: It's one of the most prestigious schools in the country.

So, it is clear that the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence is **Prestigious.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Inauspicious** means showing signs that the future will not be good or successful; unlucky.
 
• **Heterogeneous** means consisting of different kinds of people or things.
 
• **Multifarious** means having great variety or diversity; of many different kinds.
